# Fixtures for game v1.38.2

Games on Abyss recorded by @an0nfunc: two short games against the AI, and probe replays (sandbox, or skirmish against the AI) that each isolate a few kinds of command; `testdata/probes/` has a note per probe. Apart from game state they contain @an0nfunc's in-game name, and no SteamIDs. The files are written by the game and are not covered by this repository's licence.
